points.description: Gives the setup and the update rule: data labelled +/- (or the negative class flipped/handled through the labels), weights initialised (e.g. randomly), and for a point x(n) with <w,x(n)> <= 0 (misclassified) the weights are updated by Δw = η·x(n). An equivalent form such as w ← w + η·y(n)·x(n) when y(n)<w,x(n)> <= 0 also earns the marks.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if the update rule is correct but there is no initialisation or labelling step, or if the update is applied without the misclassification condition.

points.description: Gives the loop and stopping condition: go over all data points for repeated epochs until the weights stop changing (or no point is misclassified). Saying it converges because the data is linearly separable is also fine.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if there is iteration over the data but no stopping or convergence criterion.
